We compute their residues modulo 16: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 1, 3, 7, 13, 15, 5, 9, 11, 15, 5, 11, 13, 3, 7, 9, 15, 3, 9, 1.

We multiply all of these numbers modulo 16, taking advantage of the fact that $3\cdot 5 \equiv -1 (\text{mod }16)$, $7\cdot9\equiv -1 (\text{mod }16)$, $11\cdot 13\equiv -1 (\text{mod }16)$, and $15\equiv -1(\text{mod }16)$. We find that our answer is $\boxed{6}$.
